subsection.name: Writing the Model
subsection.p: The Model objects have properties to hold data from the screen components and methods to act on the data.

Appart from the generic rules to consider when writing the model, there are no specific rules to apply when writing the model for a Swing view, thanks to the clear separation between the model and the view provided by Scope.

Model objects do not have to extend any Scope base class unless it is required that the GUI reflects any changes in the state of models automatically. If automatic View updates are needed, the programmer can either call SPanel.refresh() on the View whenever there is a change, or have the Model class implement org.scopemvc.model.basic.BasicModel.
BasicModel is an abstract implementation of ModelChangeEventSource. It allows subclasses to notify listeners of changes in their state using fireModelChanged().
Since SPanel makes all SComponents as listeners of the properties in the model that they are displaying, a change in a property in the model will cause the relevant components in the view to be refreshed automatically with the new value of the property.
